item.title: Lore comparison
item.description:
Source: TW

It’s interesting how lay people (typically not scholars or Indologists) underestimate the intellectual rigour and continuity of India’s indigenous traditions. They tend to apply the same framework they apply for the Middle East to India.

Memory loss

Iraqis forgot about Hammurabi, Ashurbanipal, et al., Egyptians forgot about Khufu, Hatshepsut, et al.; Arabs forgot about Gindibuʾ, Karibʾīl Watār, et al. These figures were (re)discovered by archaeologists and epigraphers in the 18th-20th centuries.
